core_obligations: For each s in S choose i with s in the image of S_i -> S.
Apply the etale neighbourhood lemma to get an etale T_s -> S through s factoring through S_i.
Conclude {T_s -> S} is an etale covering refining the smooth covering.

proof_roadmap.step: Chart every point by the etale-neighbourhood lemma through a covering member.
Assemble the charts into a refining etale covering.

difficulty_reason: Given a smooth covering {S_i -> S} of a scheme in the sense of the Topologies chapter, the lemma produces an etale covering {T_j -> S} refining it, i.e. the etale topology is contained in the smooth topology in the strongest (refinement) sense. The retained proof is a written point-by-point assembly: every s in S lies in the image of some S_i -> S, the etale-neighbourhood lemma just collected (L16018, lemma-etale-nbhd-dominates-smooth) supplies an etale g_s : T_s -> S with s in its image factoring through S_i -> S, and the assembled family {T_s -> S} is an etale covering refining the original. Retained author proof at lines 10947-10954.
